  * # The perfect weekend in HCMC
Fine Arts Museum in Ho Chi Minh City. All photos by Christian Berg. 




## Ho Chi Minh City is bursting at the seams with [enticing experiences](https://vietnam.travel/things-to-do/how-see-hcmc-local) for travellers. A weekend is not a whole lot of time, but with the help of our insider itinerary, you'll see, do, and taste just enough to get a well-rounded picture of this dynamic metropolis.
* * *
### Saturday morning - Historic highlights
Wake up with a fresh bánh mìcà phê sữa đá Reunification Palace 
A few steps away, the Notre Dame Cathedral Saigon Central Post OfficeSaigon Opera House
> TIP: Lune Production stages riveting contemporary circus and cultural shows at the Opera House several nights a week. Score a ticket for an hour of fascinating entertainment.
* * *
### Saturday afternoon - Cafes and boutiques
Ready to eat like a local? Võ Roof Garden bún thịt nướngcơm tấm
Nguyễn Huệ is one of the only pedestrian streets in Ho Chi Minh City. Stop by Apartment 42L'Usine
* * *
### Saturday evening - Drink and dine
Feeling adventurous? Venture out for a shellfish-themed spread at Ốc OanhQuán BụiSaigon Saigon BarPasteur Street Brewing Company
> TIP: Ho Chi Minh City is awash spas and wellness centres, with options to fit every budget. If you're looking to de-stress for less, finish your day with a Vietnamese foot or body massage.
* * *
[](https://vietnam.travel/sites/default/files/360Tour/HoChiMinhCity/index.htm)
#### _[Click here to take a 360-degree tour of Ho Chi Minh City](https://vietnam.travel/sites/default/files/360Tour/HoChiMinhCity/index.htm)_
* * *
### Sunday morning - Local life
Start your Sunday with an insider view into everyday life at Tao Đàn Park
Continue the local exploration at Tân Định Market Thiên Hậu Pagoda
* * *
### Sunday afternoon - Must-see museums
You're in Vietnam, so don't miss the chance to sample some of the city's famous dishes. Treat yourself to lunch at Cục Gạch Quán
Ho Chi Minh City boasts an incredibly colourful history. Spend an afternoon checking out the War Remnants Museum Fine Arts MuseumFITO Museum
* * *
### Sunday evening - Above it all
Round out your Ho Chi Minh City weekend with a taste of modern Vietnam. Situated inside a wet market in District 1, Anan SaigonGlow Sky Bar
